task_name: Cluster High-Rise Residential Buildings Around Park and Place New Residential Zone

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When a residential upgrade completes into a mid-rise condo outside the park's optimal coverage and you want to maximize the park's percentage population bonus.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Because parks provide a percentage boost to every residential building in their green zone, clustering the highest-population apartment buildings together around the Small Fountain Park increases the park's bonus to +67 population.
preconditions: 1 Residential Zone available in the right menu
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Relocate the tall residential buildings onto adjacent road lots and position the Small Fountain Park so its green zone overlaps all of them.

steps.who: newly upgraded Bennett Condos (tap and hold to pick up)
steps.briefing: move the condo to the upper side of the residential street next to the other buildings and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: Small Fountain Park (tap and hold to pick up)
steps.briefing: move the park slightly right and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: tall Napper Tenement building (tap and hold to pick up)
steps.briefing: move the tall apartment building directly next to Bennett Condos on the left side of the street (+353 population) and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: Residential Buildings icon on the right menu
steps.briefing: drag the available Residential Zone onto the right end of the street and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: floating Metal on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect finished Metal and re-queue Metal across the factories.
